name: Esperia Greenspirit
original_name: エスペリア・グリーンスピリット
source:
A green-eyed, brown-haired girl who is known for her gentle, self-sacrificing nature. She is the unofficial leader of Rakios's Spirits, but has a tendency to think of Spirits like herself as existing to serve humans. Her halo takes the form of a shield.
[From [url=http://www.jastusa.com/aselia/chara.html]jastusa.com[/url]]
